ids is copied before execution; requested order and duplicates are preserved. expected=None accepts current content; an explicit Source rejects changes with STALE_SOURCE. Returns Batch[value], including a valid Source for empty ids. Missing objects or total-byte budgets reject the whole read without partial values or an aborted Edit. This call is synchronous and has no host-owned result lease. Recover a lost response through its original Call to retain the captured source. Example: batch = session.scene.get_many((id, id)).


## zipzi.Edit.scene.list

`(*, name: str | None=None, limit: int=128, cursor: PageCursor | None=None) -> Page[scene.Summary]`

Read a bounded metadata Page in SDK storage order, without geometry/keyform/pixel payloads.

name=None disables filtering; a string matches exactly and case-sensitively, preserving duplicate names. limit defaults to 128 and must fit the host collection-record limit; count/byte/scan budgets can produce shorter or empty pages. cursor=None starts a scan; otherwise use the previous Page.next_cursor with the same collection and filter. None as next_cursor ends the scan. A changed formal/candidate Source or Undo/Redo raises STALE_SOURCE: restart rather than merging versions. A lost response recovers the original page, even after a peer publication. This is a synchronous query; read failure does not abort an Edit and the Page needs no close. Example: page = session.scene.list(name="Face", limit=128).


## zipzi.Edit.state

`() -> EditState`

Cached confirmed or unknown client state; no request is sent.


## zipzi.EditState

`()`

Immutable typed value. See field semantics and the linked workflow.


## zipzi.Job

`(factory-owned; use the documented public entry)`

Owned accepted work returned by submit/commit/IO calls; use those factories.

wait returns the declared T and releases the bounded result slot; state does
not consume it. cancel requests cancellation and close waits for the real
outcome. A known JobTimeout keeps this Job pending. After OutcomeUnknown,
retain and recover its original Call before issuing another Job action.
Use with for close-on-exit; it waits rather than cancelling entered IO.


## zipzi.Job.__enter__

`() -> 'Job[T]'`

Return this accepted Job without polling or IO; exit waits through close().


## zipzi.Job.__exit__

`(kind: object, exception: BaseException | None, traceback: object) -> None`

Wait/close on scope exit without suppressing the body's exception.

Context arguments are supplied by Python. Normal exit propagates a Job
failure or OutcomeUnknown; during an existing exception cleanup failure
is attached as a note and the owning Job retains pending recovery.
Returns None and may block for entered work; it never implies cancel.


## zipzi.Job.cancel

`() -> None`

Request cancellation. Wait still reports the actual entered-IO result.


## zipzi.Job.close

`() -> None`

Wait for the actual outcome and release its Runtime result slot.


## zipzi.Job.pending_request

`() -> PendingRequest | None`

Return cached metadata for this owner's original pending request, or None. Reading does not send IO or recover work; retain the original OutcomeUnknown to resume it.


## zipzi.Job.state

`() -> JobState`

Query the accepted Job status without consuming its result slot. Confirmed terminal status is cached. A lost status response must be recovered before wait or cancel; this does not imply publication success.


## zipzi.Job.wait

`(*, timeout: float | None=None) -> T`

Wait for and cache the actual terminal result, releasing its slot.

None waits indefinitely. A finite nonnegative timeout raises JobTimeout
while preserving the accepted Job. Transport loss raises OutcomeUnknown
for the complete original wait, which can be recovered without replay.
A pending cancel/status request must be recovered before waiting.


## zipzi.JobState

``

Typed public API entry.


## zipzi.JobTimeout

`(message: str='Accepted Job is still pending')`

The accepted Job remains pending; retain it and wait again or cancel.

This confirmed nonterminal status has no PendingRequest and is distinct
from a lost transport reply. A timeout does not cancel the task.


## zipzi.ObjectSummary

`(id: str, name: str, object_kind: str, runtime_id: str, part_id: str | None, parent_id: str | None, enabled: bool, mesh_id: str | None, width: int | None, height: int | None, vertex_count: int | None)`

Immutable owned ObjectSummary value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `id`: Persistent canonical UUID in the selected document.
- `name`: Exact, case-sensitive display name; binding names use their mesh name.
- `object_kind`: Stable SDK kind tag, e.g. mesh, parameter, mesh_binding or image.
- `runtime_id`: SDK runtime label; empty when this kind has no runtime label.
- `part_id`: Owning Part UUID when applicable; None means no Part ownership.
- `parent_id`: Deformation or organization parent UUID when applicable.
- `enabled`: Whether the scene object is enabled; true for metadata without that field.
- `mesh_id`: Bound mesh UUID for mesh bindings; None for other collections.
- `width`: Decoded image width in pixels when known, without reading pixels.
- `height`: Decoded image height in pixels when known, without reading pixels.
- `vertex_count`: Number of mesh vertices, without cloning vertex data.

## zipzi.OutcomeUnknown

`(pending: PendingRequest, message: str)`

The original public call has an unconfirmed outcome; retain this exception.

pending identifies its immutable request, while the owning SDK wrapper keeps
the complete result projection. recover returns that original runtime type;
use recover_call for exact static typing. Further uncertainty raises another
recoverable OutcomeUnknown. Never repeat a write under a new request ID.
Recovery is synchronous, bounded by host retention/timeouts; expiration is a
structured failure rather than proof the write did not happen.


## zipzi.OutcomeUnknown.recover

`() -> object`

Recover this complete public call using its original request identity.

The result has the original method's runtime type. The exception cannot
express that method's static type; use zipzi.recover_call for typed code.
This never invokes the original method again. Repeated recovery after
resolution raises NO_PENDING_REQUEST.


## zipzi.Page

`(source: Source, items: tuple[T, ...], next_cursor: PageCursor | None = None)`

Bounded metadata page from one exact source; an empty page may still have a continuation.

- `source`: Exact formal version or candidate sequence captured for this page.
- `items`: Metadata records in native storage order; excludes geometry, keyforms and pixel payloads.
- `next_cursor`: Opaque continuation for the same domain/filter/source; None ends the scan. Stale cursors require restarting discovery.

## zipzi.PageCursor

`()`

Opaque continuation issued by a Runtime collection query.


## zipzi.PendingRequest

`(request_id: int, digest: str, operation: str)`

Immutable identity of the original request whose outcome is unknown; recover through its owning call.

- `request_id`: Original client request number; do not allocate a fresh write request to probe the outcome.
- `digest`: Digest binding the request identity to its original payload; not the payload itself.
- `operation`: Original protocol operation name used for diagnostics and recovery ownership.

## zipzi.Plan

`(factory-owned; use the documented public entry)`

Owned native plan returned by Session/Edit/address planning factories.

report is cached and remains readable after close or invalidation. Applying
through Edit requires the captured exact source and identity/context epochs;
later writes, replacement or Undo can make it stale. Apply as the first and
only Plan in a batch. Close the lease or use with after inspection/application;
closing does not publish or revoke an already accepted document change.


## zipzi.Plan.__enter__

`() -> Plan`

Check the owning client/lease locally and return this Plan without IO. Use with to close on exit; pending work must recover on its original owner. Entering does not refresh or rebind stale SDK identity.


## zipzi.Plan.__exit__

`(kind: object, exception: BaseException | None, traceback: object) -> None`

Close the owned lease on scope exit; never suppress the body exception.

Python supplies the context arguments. Closing can synchronously contact
the host. On normal exit an unknown release remains recoverable and is
raised; during an existing exception cleanup failure is added as a note.
Retain the handle for pending cleanup. No formal document write occurs.


## zipzi.Plan.close

`() -> None`

Release this owned handle once, without mutating formal model content. A lost release response keeps the original recovery owner; confirmed close is idempotent and later use fails.


## zipzi.Plan.deletion_page

`(section: modeling.DeletionSection, *, offset: int=0, limit: int=64) -> modeling.DeletionPage`

Read a bounded section of this immutable deletion report.

Source changes do not change these rows. The live Plan lease and its
original recovery owner are required; each page contains 1 to 256 rows.


## zipzi.Plan.pending_request

`() -> PendingRequest | None`

Return cached metadata for this owner's original pending request, or None. Reading does not send IO or recover work; retain the original OutcomeUnknown to resume it.


## zipzi.Plan.report

`() -> PlanReport`

Return the immutable cached report, exact Source, SDK version, affected/copied IDs, cost, losses and no-op state. No IO occurs; the report remains readable after Plan close or invalidation.


## zipzi.PlanCost

`(sample_combinations: int, payload_bytes: int, temporary_bytes: int, history_bytes: int)`

Immutable owned PlanCost value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `sample_combinations`: Number of shape-sample combinations the conversion must process.
- `payload_bytes`: Estimated owned result payload in bytes; not total process RSS.
- `temporary_bytes`: Estimated temporary working storage in bytes; not total process RSS.
- `history_bytes`: Includes the SDK's complete previous checkpoint and new candidate.

## zipzi.PlanReport

`(source: Source, version: Version, affected_ids: tuple[str, ...], copied_ids: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...], cost: PlanCost | None, losses: tuple[str, ...], no_op: bool | None, deletion: modeling.DeletionSummary | None)`

Immutable owned PlanReport value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `source`: Exact formal or candidate source captured for this result; later host changes do not
rewrite it.
- `version`: Exact SDK version captured for this value; not a best-effort latest-version marker.
- `affected_ids`: Stable IDs conservatively affected by the planned operation.
- `copied_ids`: Mapping from original object IDs to the new IDs allocated for copied objects.
- `cost`: Native plan cost estimates; inspect losses separately before applying the plan.
- `losses`: Explicit semantic losses predicted by conversion; empty means no losses were reported.
- `no_op`: Whether applying the plan would leave the document unchanged.
- `deletion`: Bounded deletion readiness/count summary; detailed rows use frozen report pages.

pixels() synchronously downloads owned bytes. A pending request must recover
on this original owner. Handles cannot cross Runtime/client boundaries.

Python supplies the context arguments. Closing can synchronously contact

raised; during an existing exception cleanup failure is added as a note.

## zipzi.PreparedImage.close

## zipzi.Receipt

Confirmed publication result returned by a completed commit; constructing a DTO does not publish.

- `before`: Exact formal SDK version before publication.

## zipzi.Runtime

`(factory-owned; use the documented public entry)`

Explicit client lifetime. Construct with zipzi.local() or zipzi.connect(); Connected keeps formal sessions resident after client close.


## zipzi.Runtime.__enter__

`() -> 'Runtime'`

Return this factory-created Runtime; no new host/client or IO is started.


## zipzi.Runtime.__exit__

`(kind: object, exception: BaseException | None, traceback: object) -> None`

Close on scope exit without saving or suppressing the body exception.

Python supplies the context arguments. close may block on entered work
or raise Busy/OutcomeUnknown for pending ownership. With an existing
exception, cleanup failure is added as a note. Connected documents stay
resident; Local releases its Runtime sessions. Returns None.


## zipzi.Runtime.capabilities

`() -> RuntimeCapabilities`

Query actual implementation and environment capabilities; this does not reserve future admission.


## zipzi.Runtime.close

`(*, abandon_pending: bool=False) -> None`

Release this client/Local Runtime; pending recovery defaults to Busy.

Explicit abandon_pending disconnects and forfeits pending recovery.
It never changes identity to replay an unknown write. Connected sessions
remain resident; entered host Jobs retain their actual outcome.


## zipzi.Runtime.connection

`() -> ConnectionInfo | None`

Immutable negotiated host metadata; local runtimes return None.

Read a bounded event page after an exact registry/session Cursor. Limit is 1..256; Runtime identity or retained-history gaps raise RESYNC_REQUIRED. Recover a lost response to obtain its original page.


## zipzi.Runtime.limits

Query current Runtime count, byte and scan budgets. Values are estimates, not process RSS limits.


## zipzi.Runtime.resources

`(backend: Backend)`

Immutable typed value. See field semantics and the linked workflow.


## zipzi.Runtime.resources.load_png

`(path: Path) -> Job[PreparedImage]`

Submit decoding a host-absolute PNG into a PreparedImage Job. Wait for the accepted job and close the resulting lease; decoder failures do not poison an unrelated Edit.


## zipzi.Runtime.resources.prepare_buffer

`(data: bytes | bytearray | memoryview) -> Buffer`

Own bytes in a reusable immutable host Buffer, with bounded upload and original-request recovery. Preparation does not edit a document; explicitly close the Buffer after use.


## zipzi.Runtime.resources.prepare_image

`(width: int, height: int, rgba: bytes | bytearray | memoryview | Buffer) -> PreparedImage`

Own RGBA8 bytes or an immutable Buffer and prepare a width-by-height image lease. Preparation does not edit a document. Close the lease after candidate acceptance; SDK/history owners retain their references.

## zipzi.Runtime.sessions

`(runtime: Runtime)`

Bounded host registry. Listing and attaching share the resident document; neither creates a Python mirror.


## zipzi.Runtime.sessions.attach

`(id: SessionId) -> 'Session'`

Bind this client to an existing Runtime-scoped SessionId without copying content. Detached old wrappers stay invalid; a successful attach creates a fresh binding. Wrong Runtime or missing IDs fail.


## zipzi.Runtime.sessions.create

`(document_id: str | None=None) -> 'Session'`

Synchronously create a resident document with SDK defaults and return its client Session binding. document_id=None allocates a canonical UUID in Rust; an explicit value must be a valid document UUID. Host Session/client-slot and memory budgets apply. A new document is unsaved and modified: save it or explicitly permit discard when closing. A lost reply must recover this original call, never create another Session. Use session.close() to free the host document, or detach() to keep it resident. Example: session = runtime.sessions.create().


## zipzi.Runtime.sessions.import_

`(path: Path, format: modeling.ImportFormat, *, textures: tuple[modeling.TextureSlot, ...]=()) -> Job['Session']`

Submit an explicit host format import into a new session. Textures are explicit host paths. Wait for Job[Session]; cancellation reports the real outcome if IO has already entered.


## zipzi.Runtime.sessions.list

`() -> tuple[SessionInfo, ...]`

Read one bounded tuple of resident SessionInfo values. Registry order uses SessionId. No object geometry or pixel payload is returned; transport loss recovers the captured tuple.


## zipzi.Runtime.sessions.open

`(path: Path) -> Job['Session']`

Submit host-absolute project open and return Job[Session], including already-open paths through a cached completed Job. Wait for the actual outcome; recover a lost start before waiting.


## zipzi.Runtime.sessions.subscribe

`() -> events.RegistrySubscription`

Capture current registry metadata and an independent cursor. Poll bounded pages; resync explicitly after RESYNC_REQUIRED. This does not drain another subscriber.


## zipzi.RuntimeCapabilities

`(domains: tuple[str, ...], pagination: bool, source_checked_reads: bool, session_close: bool, binary_arrays: bool, editor_windows: bool, gpu: bool | None, gpu_backend: str, gpu_error: str | None)`

Immutable owned RuntimeCapabilities value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `domains`: Finite domain names supported by this host; absence means the domain is unavailable.
- `pagination`: Whether this host supports source-bound bounded collection pagination.
- `source_checked_reads`: Whether selected reads accept an exact expected Source.
- `session_close`: Whether this host supports explicit Session detach/close.
- `binary_arrays`: Whether this host supports the paired binary array transport.
- `editor_windows`: Whether Session window display is supported by this host.
- `gpu`: GPU availability: false without GPU support; otherwise None before probing, true after rendering, false after adapter/device failure.
This cached observation is not a guarantee for a later render; CPU sampling is independent.
- `gpu_backend`: Compiled observation backend family: Metal on macOS, WGPU elsewhere, or None without GPU support. No device is initialized by this read.
- `gpu_error`: GPU_UNAVAILABLE without GPU support; otherwise the last adapter/device failure code, or None before probing or after a successful render.

## zipzi.RuntimeLimits

`(previews_per_client: int, preview_bytes: int, preview_schedule_entries: int, preview_seek_cache_bytes: int, collection_records: int, collection_bytes: int, collection_scan: int, clients: int, sessions: int, edits_per_client_session: int, edits_per_session: int, edits_total: int, candidate_bytes: int, frozen_bytes: int, accounted_bytes: int, image_bytes: int, plans_per_client: int, references_per_client: int, prepared_images_per_client: int, plan_bytes: int, blob_bytes: int, blobs_per_client: int, history_bytes: int, jobs_total: int, jobs_per_client: int, running_jobs: int, session_events: int, session_event_bytes: int, registry_events: int, registry_event_bytes: int)`

Immutable owned RuntimeLimits value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `previews_per_client`: Maximum independent frozen animation Previews owned by one client.
- `preview_bytes`: Conservative aggregate Preview storage limit, including replay/cache workspace.
- `preview_schedule_entries`: Maximum retained activations per Preview; Reset retains schedules.
- `preview_seek_cache_bytes`: SDK checkpoint-cache budget per Preview; transient replay state is charged separately.
- `collection_records`: Maximum records returned by one collection page or selected batch.
- `collection_bytes`: Maximum escaped metadata bytes in one collection page.
- `collection_scan`: Maximum entries examined by one collection page.
- `clients`: Maximum registered clients; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `sessions`: Maximum resident document Sessions; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `edits_per_client_session`: Maximum simultaneous candidates per client/Session pair; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `edits_per_session`: Maximum simultaneous candidates per Session; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `edits_total`: Maximum simultaneous candidates in this Runtime; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `candidate_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for candidate document storage; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `frozen_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for frozen snapshots and queued work; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `accounted_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for aggregate Runtime-accounted storage; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `image_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for retained image storage; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `plans_per_client`: Maximum retained plans per client; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `references_per_client`: Maximum retained object/field references per client; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `prepared_images_per_client`: Maximum prepared images per client; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `plan_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for retained plan storage; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `blob_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for retained binary blob storage; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `blobs_per_client`: Maximum retained binary blobs per client; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `history_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for retained undo/redo history; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `jobs_total`: Maximum retained Jobs in the Runtime; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `jobs_per_client`: Maximum retained Jobs per client; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `running_jobs`: Maximum concurrently running host Jobs; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `session_events`: Maximum retained events per Session stream; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `session_event_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for event payloads per Session stream; not RSS or GPU memory.
- `registry_events`: Maximum retained events in the registry stream; this is a count, not a byte limit.
- `registry_event_bytes`: Conservative byte limit for registry event payloads; not RSS or GPU memory.

## zipzi.SaveReceipt

`(manifest: Path, durable: bool, before: Version, after: Version)`

Confirmed save outcome; inspect durable and the actual host manifest path.

- `manifest`: Absolute manifest path reported by the host; not a path resolved on the client.
- `durable`: Whether the save achieved its persistence guarantee; completion alone does not imply true.
- `before`: SDK version captured before saving.
- `after`: SDK version reported after saving.

## zipzi.SdkFailure

`(code: str, message: str, *, operation: str='', object_ids: tuple[str, ...]=(), expected_version: Version | None=None, actual_version: Version | None=None, field_path: str | None=None, referrers: tuple[str, ...]=(), edit_state: str | None=None, project_report: ProjectReport | None=None, recovery_action: RecoveryAction | None=None, requested: int | None=None, allowed: int | None=None, limit_name: str | None=None)`

Confirmed SDK/host refusal with structured recovery and ownership facts.

code is the stable discriminator; message is human-readable. operation and
object_ids identify the attempted domain action. expected_version,
actual_version, field_path and referrers explain stale/invalid references.
edit_state distinguishes aborted candidates from confirmed admission refusal.
requested/allowed are counts or bytes named by limit_name; None means absent.
project_report retains a failed IO report when available. recovery_action
recommends a finite next action; it is not permission to replay unknown work.
OutcomeUnknown has a separate retained request owner and recover method.
This value alone performs no IO and owns no resource lease. Catch outside a
failed Edit, inspect code/recovery_action, and start a fresh candidate when
required. See docs/guide.md for the error/recovery workflow.


## zipzi.Session

`(factory-owned; use the documented public entry)`

One client binding to a resident document. Use runtime.sessions factories; aliases share detach/close state. id is pure cached identity, while info queries host state.


## zipzi.Session.address

`(selector: modeling.AddressSelector) -> references.FieldAddress`

Capture a field address with incarnation, context and field epochs. The returned handle owns a lease and must be closed; recreated IDs cannot revive an old address.


## zipzi.Session.bindings

`(session: '_lifecycle.Session', edit: '_lifecycle.Edit | None'=None)`

Immutable typed value. See field semantics and the linked workflow.


## zipzi.Session.bindings.get

`(id: str, *, expected: Source | None=None) -> Snapshot[bindings.MeshBinding]`

Read one owned value at an exact formal or candidate Source.

id is the stable document object ID, not a name. expected=None reads current content; an explicit Source is checked atomically and stale sources raise STALE_SOURCE. Returns Snapshot[value] with the captured Source; reading its fields performs no IO. This synchronous call uses one bounded selected read and may reject missing IDs or response budgets. Query failures do not abort an Edit. After OutcomeUnknown recover the original call to get the original captured result; do not replace it with a fresh read. The result owns no host lease. Example: snapshot = session.bindings.get(id); value = snapshot.value.


## zipzi.Session.bindings.get_many

`(ids: Sequence[str], *, expected: Source | None=None) -> Batch[bindings.MeshBinding]`

Read all selected IDs atomically from one formal or candidate Source.

ids is copied before execution; requested order and duplicates are preserved. expected=None accepts current content; an explicit Source rejects changes with STALE_SOURCE. Returns Batch[value], including a valid Source for empty ids. Missing objects or total-byte budgets reject the whole read without partial values or an aborted Edit. This call is synchronous and has no host-owned result lease. Recover a lost response through its original Call to retain the captured source. Example: batch = session.bindings.get_many((id, id)).


## zipzi.Session.bindings.list

`(*, name: str | None=None, limit: int=128, cursor: PageCursor | None=None) -> Page[bindings.Summary]`

Read a bounded metadata Page in SDK storage order, without geometry/keyform/pixel payloads.

name=None disables filtering; a string matches exactly and case-sensitively, preserving duplicate names. limit defaults to 128 and must fit the host collection-record limit; count/byte/scan budgets can produce shorter or empty pages. cursor=None starts a scan; otherwise use the previous Page.next_cursor with the same collection and filter. None as next_cursor ends the scan. A changed formal/candidate Source or Undo/Redo raises STALE_SOURCE: restart rather than merging versions. A lost response recovers the original page, even after a peer publication. This is a synchronous query; read failure does not abort an Edit and the Page needs no close. Example: page = session.bindings.list(name="Face", limit=128).


## zipzi.Session.capabilities

`(query: modeling.CollectionQuery) -> Snapshot[modeling.Capabilities]`

Query selected collection capabilities at the captured formal Source. Results explain available/unavailable/unsupported states and do not reserve future admission.


## zipzi.Session.close

`(*, discard_modified: bool=False) -> SessionInfo`

Close the host document and return its final SessionInfo, without saving.

discard_modified=False protects unsaved changes, including a newly created
document. True explicitly permits discarding them only; it does not bypass
other clients, active candidates or work. Confirmed refusal preserves the
document. This synchronous call frees the Session slot/path and invalidates
this client's aliases and child references. Independent prepared resources
keep their own leases. Confirmed close is cached/idempotent; a lost response
must recover the original close and returns the same final metadata.
Example: session.close(discard_modified=True) when discarding is intended.


## zipzi.Session.detach

`() -> None`

Release this client's binding and its references. Active work refuses detach; the host session remains resident. Aliases become invalid.

`(label: str) -> 'Edit'`

Begin an explicit candidate with a history label. Reads see candidate changes; normal context exit commits and waits. Confirmed write failures require a new Edit and unknown outcomes require original-call recovery.


## zipzi.Session.editor_context

`() -> Snapshot[modeling.EditorContext | None]`

Read an owned optional Editor context and exact formal Source. Local or non-Editor hosts can return None; no Editor object is exposed.


## zipzi.Session.id

`() -> SessionId`

Return cached Runtime-scoped identity without IO. Persistent object IDs belong to this session and do not substitute for a SessionId.


## zipzi.Session.info

`() -> SessionInfo`

Read current version, modified state, history lengths, path and host state. Returns an owned value; a lost response recovers the original query.


## zipzi.Session.meshes

`(session: '_lifecycle.Session', edit: '_lifecycle.Edit | None'=None)`

Immutable typed value. See field semantics and the linked workflow.


## zipzi.Session.meshes.get

`(id: str, *, expected: Source | None=None) -> Snapshot[meshes.Mesh]`

Read one owned value at an exact formal or candidate Source.

id is the stable document object ID, not a name. expected=None reads current content; an explicit Source is checked atomically and stale sources raise STALE_SOURCE. Returns Snapshot[value] with the captured Source; reading its fields performs no IO. This synchronous call uses one bounded selected read and may reject missing IDs or response budgets. Query failures do not abort an Edit. After OutcomeUnknown recover the original call to get the original captured result; do not replace it with a fresh read. The result owns no host lease. Example: snapshot = session.meshes.get(id); value = snapshot.value.


## zipzi.Session.meshes.get_many

`(ids: Sequence[str], *, expected: Source | None=None) -> Batch[meshes.Mesh]`

Read all selected IDs atomically from one formal or candidate Source.

ids is copied before execution; requested order and duplicates are preserved. expected=None accepts current content; an explicit Source rejects changes with STALE_SOURCE. Returns Batch[value], including a valid Source for empty ids. Missing objects or total-byte budgets reject the whole read without partial values or an aborted Edit. This call is synchronous and has no host-owned result lease. Recover a lost response through its original Call to retain the captured source. Example: batch = session.meshes.get_many((id, id)).


## zipzi.Session.meshes.list

`(*, name: str | None=None, limit: int=128, cursor: PageCursor | None=None) -> Page[meshes.Summary]`

Read a bounded metadata Page in SDK storage order, without geometry/keyform/pixel payloads.

name=None disables filtering; a string matches exactly and case-sensitively, preserving duplicate names. limit defaults to 128 and must fit the host collection-record limit; count/byte/scan budgets can produce shorter or empty pages. cursor=None starts a scan; otherwise use the previous Page.next_cursor with the same collection and filter. None as next_cursor ends the scan. A changed formal/candidate Source or Undo/Redo raises STALE_SOURCE: restart rather than merging versions. A lost response recovers the original page, even after a peer publication. This is a synchronous query; read failure does not abort an Edit and the Page needs no close. Example: page = session.meshes.list(name="Face", limit=128).


## zipzi.Session.modeling

`(session: '_lifecycle.Session', edit: '_lifecycle.Edit | None'=None)`

Immutable typed value. See field semantics and the linked workflow.


## zipzi.Session.modeling.observe

`(poses: Sequence[Mapping[str, float]], view: observation.View, *, expected: Source | None=None) -> '_lifecycle.Job[Snapshot[observation.Batch]]'`

Render 1..64 explicit parameter poses from an exact frozen Source. The explicit Y-up model ROI preserves aspect ratio; frames contain GPU RGBA8, Rust-encoded PNG, view mapping, actual adapter and texture hashes. view.quality includes per-mesh geometry and sampled source-alpha coverage; view.topology enables wireframe, persistent vertex IDs, constraints and strain overlays with the same frozen mapping. Rendering resolves one immutable texture set per batch, never publishes history and does not abort an Edit on failure. Device initialization occurs on the worker; missing GPU produces a structured failure, independently of CPU operations. Runtime count/byte/device budgets apply. Recover a lost submission or result through its original Call; wait/close the Job to release its result slot.


## zipzi.Session.modeling.records

`(query: modeling.ModelingQuery) -> Snapshot[modeling.OwnedModelingRecords]`

Read selected canonical records from one exact source without editing. query lists stable IDs per domain; empty lists request no payloads, while the ids directory still exposes collection identities. Returns an owned Snapshot; payload slots follow query order and None marks a missing requested ID. This synchronous query may reject count/byte budgets but does not abort an Edit. Recover a lost response through its original Call; results need no close. Example: result = session.modeling.records(modeling.ModelingQuery(meshes=(id,))).


## zipzi.Session.modeling.sample

`(poses: Sequence[Mapping[str, float]], *, checks: sampling.Checks=sampling.Checks(), expected: Source | None=None) -> Snapshot[sampling.Result]`

Synchronously evaluate CPU poses without editing or GPU work. poses is an ordered sequence of parameter-ID/value maps in each parameter domain; inputs are owned before execution. checks supplies authored validity diagnostics and, with quality=True, per-pose model-space mesh quality relative to this frozen source at default parameters; quality reports do not cover unsampled intervals. expected=None accepts current content while an explicit Source rejects changes atomically. Returns Snapshot[sampling.Result] with frames in pose order. Native count/byte/work budgets apply; query/diagnostic failure does not abort an Edit. A lost result recovers through its original multi-stage Call, never by silently resampling current content. Owned results need no close. Example: sampled = session.modeling.sample(({parameter_id: 0.5},)).


## zipzi.Session.modeling.sample_async

`(poses: Sequence[Mapping[str, float]], *, checks: sampling.Checks=sampling.Checks(), expected: Source | None=None) -> '_lifecycle.Job[Snapshot[sampling.Result]]'`

Submit CPU evaluation of poses at the captured exact Source and return Job[Snapshot[sampling.Result]]. poses, checks and expected have the same semantics as sample; this named API always returns a Job rather than switching by input size. Native admission can reject work/count/byte budgets before acceptance. After an unknown submission recover the original Job instead of submitting another. Wait for the actual owned result and close/wait the Job to release its bounded result slot; JobTimeout keeps it pending. Example: with session.modeling.sample_async(({parameter_id: 0.5},)) as job: sampled = job.wait().


## zipzi.Session.modeling.spatial

`(poses: Sequence[Mapping[str, float]], queries: Sequence[_spatial.Query], *, expected: Source | None=None) -> '_lifecycle.Job[Snapshot[_spatial.Batch]]'`

Submit frozen CPU geometry queries for explicit parameter poses. Returns Job[Snapshot[spatial.Batch]] with effective parameters, exact Source, requested queries and ordered bounds/hit results. Coordinates are Y-up model units, never screen pixels; hidden geometry is explicitly selectable. Candidate reads do not publish or abort an Edit. A lost submission/result recovers the original call rather than querying newer content. No textures, masks, occlusion or GPU are used.

## zipzi.Session.plan

`(operation: ops.PlannableOperation) -> plans.Plan`

Plan a registered typed domain operation against the exact formal Source. Read cost/losses, apply through an Edit, then close the Plan. Planning failures do not abort another candidate.


## zipzi.Session.plan_async

`(operation: ModelingPlanOperation) -> Job[plans.Plan]`

Submit a registered expensive modeling plan at the captured Source. Returns Job[Plan]; wait before applying and close the resulting Plan. Input type determines this explicit Job API.


## zipzi.Session.preview

`(*, expected: Source | None=None) -> Preview`

Capture an independent frozen formal animation Preview. Close it explicitly; later edits never refresh it, and playback never changes document history.


## zipzi.Session.project

`(session: Session)`

Host-side format and persistence operations. Every path is absolute on the selected execution host; IO returns explicit Jobs.


## zipzi.Session.project.diagnose

`() -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit SDK project diagnostics without publishing edited model content. Returns Job[ProjectReport] with owned diagnostics; wait releases the result slot.


## zipzi.Session.project.export

`(path: Path, format: modeling.ExportFormat, *, name: str='model', object_id: str | None=None, allow_loss: bool=False, bake_animation: bool=False, auto_frame_rate: bool=False) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit a selected export to a host-absolute path. allow_loss, animation baking and frame-rate choices are explicit. Read report losses/published and wait for the durable IO outcome.


## zipzi.Session.project.open

`(path: Path) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Replace this session from an absolute host project path through an explicit Job. Successful replacement advances generation and invalidates old source-bound addresses/plans.


## zipzi.Session.project.replace

`(path: Path, format: modeling.ImportFormat, *, textures: tuple[modeling.TextureSlot, ...]=()) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit explicit format import to replace this session. Textures are host-absolute slots. Wait for the real report; generation changes only after confirmed publication.


## zipzi.Session.project.run

`(request: modeling.ProjectRequest) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit one typed ProjectRequest and return Job[ProjectReport]. Input selects explicit format/IO policy; losses and notices belong to the report. Wait and verify before claiming publication.


## zipzi.Session.project.save

`(path: Path) -> Job[SaveReceipt]`

Submit saving to host-absolute project folder path and return Job[SaveReceipt]. Wait for the receipt, then inspect durable and its before/after versions before claiming persistence. A client-side Path.exists is not evidence of host persistence. Recover an unknown submission/wait through its original Call; do not submit another save to probe its outcome. The Job owns a bounded result slot released by wait/close. Example: saved = session.project.save(absolute_folder).wait(); assert saved.durable.


## zipzi.Session.redo

`() -> Job[Receipt]`

Submit one formal history redo and return Job[Receipt]. Wait for the actual receipt. Cancelling or a no-op Edit preserves redo according to SDK history rules.


## zipzi.Session.reference

`(kind: references.ObjectKind, id: str) -> references.ObjectRef`

Capture an SDK object reference for the declared kind and canonical UUID. Runtime validates session ownership and incarnation. Close the returned reference after use.

## zipzi.Session.resources.snapshot

`(id: str) -> resources.ImageLease`

Capture pixels of image id at this exact formal/candidate source into an independent ImageLease. This synchronous request can reject a missing image or lease/byte budget; queries do not abort an Edit. The lease pins pixels across replacement and history eviction: close it or use with. Its source is cached, and pixels() returns owned ImagePixels. Recover an unknown capture through its original Call. Example: with session.resources.snapshot(id) as lease: pixels = lease.pixels().

## zipzi.Session.show_window

`() -> None`

Synchronously display this resident document in the connected desktop host.

Requires runtime.capabilities().editor_windows; Local/CPU-only hosts can
reject it with SdkFailure. Returns None, changes UI visibility rather
than model/history, and owns no new client lease. Recover an unknown
response through the original call before requesting another window.
Example: session.show_window().


## zipzi.Session.subscribe

`() -> events.SessionSubscription`

Capture SessionInfo and an independent exact event cursor. Poll explicit bounded pages and resync on gaps; subscribed metadata does not hold a model mirror.


## zipzi.Session.undo

`() -> Job[Receipt]`

Submit one formal history undo and return Job[Receipt]. Wait for confirmed content/version/history; conflicting or busy sessions reject without silently changing the target.


## zipzi.SessionId

`(runtime: str, serial: int)`

Runtime-scoped Session identity, independent of paths and persistent document UUIDs.

- `runtime`: Canonical UUID of the Runtime instance that allocated the handle.
- `serial`: Positive u64 Session serial within that Runtime; not the document UUID or SDK session_id.

## zipzi.SessionInfo

`(version: Version, modified: bool, history: tuple[int, int], id: SessionId, state: str, path: Path | None)`

Immutable Session metadata captured by the host; reading it does not refresh the Session.

- `version`: Exact SDK version captured with this metadata.
- `modified`: Whether the document has unsaved changes; default Session.close refuses a modified document.
- `history`: Pair of undo-step and redo-step counts, in that order.
- `id`: Runtime-scoped Session identity; not the persistent document UUID.
- `state`: Captured lifecycle state: ready, busy, faulted, closing or closed.
- `path`: Host project path; None means the Session has no associated project path.

## zipzi.Snapshot

`(source: Source, value: T)`

One owned domain value at an exact formal or candidate source; field access performs no IO.

- `source`: Exact source captured atomically with the payload.
- `value`: Owned immutable domain payload; retain source separately when planning or checking freshness.

## zipzi.Source

`(runtime: str, session: int, version: Version, edit: int | None = None, sequence: int = 0)`

Exact immutable formal or candidate source used by a read or plan; copying it performs no IO.

- `runtime`: Canonical UUID of the Runtime instance owning the source.
- `session`: Runtime Session serial; together with runtime identifies the resident document.
- `version`: Exact formal version, or the formal base version captured by the candidate.
- `edit`: Candidate Edit serial; None means a formal document source.
- `sequence`: Exact candidate sequence; formal sources use the default 0. Later candidate writes invalidate old sequences.

## zipzi.Version

`(session_id: int, generation: int, revision: int)`

Exact SDK document version; compare the complete value rather than revision alone.

- `session_id`: SDK authoring-session identity, distinct from the Runtime Session serial.
- `generation`: Document incarnation within the SDK session; replacing/opening content invalidates older generations.
- `revision`: Document revision within this generation; not a Runtime event cursor or Edit sequence.

## zipzi.WriteResult

`(source: Source, ids: tuple[str, ...], mesh_transfer: 'ManualMeshTransferReport | None' = None)`

Confirmed candidate write result; it is not a formal commit receipt.

- `source`: Exact candidate source after the accepted write call.
- `ids`: Operation result IDs in operation order; may name newly created or existing objects.
- `mesh_transfer`: UV sampling, dependency and finite-cost report for a manual mesh write; otherwise None.

## zipzi.connect

`(*, endpoint: Path | None=None, start: bool=False, host: Path | None=None, timeout: float=10.0, startup_timeout: float=15.0, sdk_build: str | None=None) -> Runtime`

Connect to an explicit/discovered host and return an owned Runtime client.

endpoint is an absolute private Unix socket path or a local Windows Named
Pipe name; None discovers it from ZIPZI_RUNTIME_DIR/ZIPZI_RUNTIME_PROFILE.
On Windows, start=True requires the discovered endpoint (or None).
start=False never launches a
process. With start=True, host is an absolute executable, or discovery uses
ZIPZI_EDITOR_HOST and the supported app locations. host requires start=True.
timeout is the positive finite per-request transport timeout in seconds;
startup_timeout is the positive finite total startup/handshake budget.
sdk_build=None accepts any host build with the same wire protocol major;
an explicit string additionally requires an exact build match. Optional
capabilities do not gate connection; inspect runtime.connection.capabilities
before selecting host services. Installing native never changes the host.

This blocks for connection/startup, raising ValueError for invalid options,
PermissionError for unsafe endpoint ownership, OS connection errors when
no host is listening, or SdkFailure for pairing/startup refusal. Runtime
resources are bounded by host limits. Close the returned client or use with;
this releases its leases while formal Connected sessions remain resident.
A request that later becomes unknown must recover on this original Runtime;
calling connect again does not replay or resolve that request.

Example: with zipzi.connect(endpoint=absolute_socket_path) as runtime: ...


## zipzi.describe

`(path: str) -> ApiDescription`

Look up an exact public path, e.g. Session.meshes.list, without IO or eval.

Unknown paths raise KeyError. Short paths are normalized under zipzi.
The root description links the bundled short guide and executable recipes.
Use print(describe(path).format()) for complete help; direct printing is a
bounded preview. Fields and child paths are also available individually.
This describes the installed API, while runtime.capabilities() describes
the connected host. No resource is constructed or RPC sent by this query.


## zipzi.local

`() -> Runtime`

Explicitly create an owned in-process Runtime with the paired optional native wheel. Importing zipzi alone does not start it. Use as a context manager; close releases its sessions without saving or connecting to another host.


## zipzi.recover_call

`(method: Callable[P, U], /, *args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> U`

Call a registered SDK request method once and recover its Call once.

Parameters exactly match the bound SDK method, preserving its return type.
Arbitrary functions, lambdas and unregistered wrappers raise TypeError before
execution. Busy, ordinary failures, budgets and JobTimeout are propagated.
If recovery is still unknown, retain that exception and its owner to resume
later; this helper never replays a user function or loops on recovery.
